proposals.defect: scripts/quant/sec/normalize.py adds every observation regardless of whether its period_end lies after its availability; restatements.FactTimeline.visible gates only on availability, and consumer/PeriodResolver order periods by label, so a future-dated context (schedule, declaration, mis-dated comparative, cover-date typo) becomes the 'latest' period (AAL/AXR/ASLE/PFIS/THM/REPX shares, LEGH tax, PMT debt maturities 2022-2030).
proposals.sourceEvidence: availability-before-period-end.json (904 rows, classes) and availability-sample-verification.json (79 rows, 77 original instances: 73 contexts literally in the filer instance, 6 filer cover dates after acceptance that normalize re-dated).
proposals.change: normalize.py normalize_company, before factbook.add_observation: `if period_end and str(provenance.available_from or fact.filed)[:10] < period_end: issues.append(_issue('FUTURE_PERIOD_END', fact, 'period ends after the filing became available', metric=metric_name)); continue`. Quarantine (exclude) rather than availability=max(acceptance, period_end): the latter would, once the date passes, admit maturity-schedule amounts, next-period dividend declarations and mis-dated comparatives as that period's reported value.
